title: Verify cancellation during a slow content refresh
changes: Record live DBG2-15 status, listing and targeted cancellation while a bounded content scan is in progress.
validation: In a copied Wine/Xvfb session, a refresh over 2048 inert files remained pending while the previous generation was listed. A wrong cancellation ID was refused; exact-ID cancellation returned cancelled, cleared pending status and left the prior index unchanged after the worker finished. Parent state, frame and clock, original inputs and session pins stayed unchanged; session and display closed.
limitations: This uses one synthetic bounded scan under Wine/interpreter. Cancellation is cooperative and discards the result after the scanner returns; native Windows, physical input and full operation parity remain unverified.
